function.name: make_webapi_call
function.description: Executes a call to a specified Web API endpoint with given parameters and returns the response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

endpoint.description: The URL of the Web API endpoint to be called.

method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the API call.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested or submitted.

params.description: Query parameters to be appended to the endpoint URL.

query.description: The search term for the query.

body.description: The JSON payload to be sent with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.

data.description: The actual data to be sent in the request body.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for a server response before timing out. This is a float type value.

Here’s a quick guide you can follow to locate a three‑bedroom apartment in Zürich: | Step | What to Do | Why It Helps | |------|------------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Define Your Priorities** | • Budget range
• Desired district(s) (e.g., Altstadt, Seefeld, Oerlikon)
• Proximity to public transport, schools, parks, workplaces
• Must‑have features (balcony, parking, furnished?)
• Lease length preference (short‑term vs long‑stay) | Having clear criteria narrows your search quickly and saves time. | | **2️⃣ Use Dedicated Real‑Estate Portals** | • **Homegate.ch** – Switzerland’s largest portal; offers advanced filtering (price, size, floor plan).
• **ImmoScout24.ch** – great for comparing prices across districts.
• **Newhome.ch / Newcity.ch** – focus on new builds & modern apartments.
• **Zürcher Immobilien AG** – specialized agency site for Zürich rentals. | These sites aggregate most available listings and let you filter exactly for “3 bedrooms” + other specs. | | **3️⃣ Set Up Alerts** | Most portals allow email/SMS alerts when a property matching your filters appears. Turn them on so you’re notified instantly rather than hunting manually each day. | You’ll get first‑look advantage over competitors. | | **4️⃣ Check Local Community Boards & Social Media Groups** | • Facebook groups such as *“Wohnungen und Zimmer in Zürich”* or *“Rentals in Zürich”*.
• Nextdoor.com community pages for specific neighborhoods. | Some landlords post there instead of official portals—great for hidden gems. | | **5️⃣ Contact Property Management Companies Directly** | • **Wüest Partner**, **Häusler Group**, **Bauhaus Zürich** – they manage many high‑quality units.
• Call their office, explain what you’re looking for, and ask for upcoming availability. | Personal outreach often uncovers unlisted properties or early leads. | | **6️⃣ Prepare Your Documents Early** | Swiss tenancy law requires:
- Proof of income (last 3 payslips or employment contract)
- Credit report (“Schufa”) or reference letter from previous landlord
- ID/passport copy
- Sometimes a guarantor statement if required
- Deposit (usually 3 months’ rent) | Being ready speeds up application processing once you spot a suitable unit. | | **7️⃣ Visit In Person (If Possible)** | Even if you’re remote, try arranging virtual tours via video calls. If you’re nearby, schedule visits during weekdays to avoid peak traffic times. | Seeing the space firsthand helps confirm layout, natural light, noise level, and overall condition. | | **8️⃣ Understand Rental Terms** | • Typical lease duration: 12–36 months (some short‑term options exist).
• Renewal clauses: usually automatic unless otherwise stated.
• Utilities: Often separate billing; clarify which utilities are included.
• Maintenance responsibilities: Confirm whether tenant handles minor repairs or it falls under management. | Knowing this prevents surprises later and ensures the deal fits your lifestyle. | ### Quick Tips for Specific Districts | District | Highlights | Ideal For | |----------|-------------|-----------| | **Altstetten** | Affordable rents, good tram connections, close to city center. | Young professionals, families seeking balance between cost and convenience. | | **Oerlikon** | Modern housing stock, excellent S-Bahn station, vibrant nightlife. | Tech workers, students. | | **Seebach/Zurich West** | Trendy lofts, proximity to business hubs, green spaces. | Creative industries, startups. | | **Langstrasse** | Diverse cultural scene, affordable entry point into central Zürich. | International residents, newcomers. | --- #### Need More Help? Feel free to share: - Your approximate monthly budget - Preferred neighborhood(s) - Any non‑negotiable requirements With those details I can tailor more precise recommendations or even draft sample messages to landlords/agencies!
